name: LRU Cache with Time-To-Live (TTL) Eviction
description: Implement LRUCache with capacity limits and TTL expiration support.

inputs.task_prompt: Implement LRUCache<K, V> in src/lru-cache.ts: 1) Constructor accepts capacity: number and defaultTtlMs?: number. 2) Methods: set(key, value, ttlMs?), get(key), has(key), delete(key), size(), clear(). 3) When capacity is exceeded, evict the least recently used item. 4) When an item's TTL expires, get/has must return undefined/false and remove it. Ensure test/lru-cache.test.ts passes.

acceptance_criteria: Evicts least recently used items on capacity overflow
constraints: get() operation must mark accessed item as most recently used
